narrative: Unsloth Studio's June build closes the fine-tune to local-agent loop on hardware a developer already owns, wiring a locally-served Gemma 4 12B into an MCP tool-calling client. That confirms the autonomous local-agent workload exists, the precise demand the predicted 1-PFLOP deskside silicon is built to run.
remaining_gap: Unsloth ships an application layer, not a deskside 1-PFLOP reference part, and no paired sandbox-runtime spec accompanies any silicon.
